2608.03769.title: MDLMPE: Distribution Aware Positional Encoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models
2608.03769.paper_summary: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) enable parallel generation and bidirectional context modeling, but their positional context differs fundamentally from that of autoregressive (AR) models. Whereas AR decoding exposes a contiguous prefix, MDLM denoising produces dynamic, non-contiguous configurations of revealed and masked tokens. Conventional positional encodings such as RoPE capture sequence order and pairwise displacement but remain insensitive to this evolving token-availability structure. To address this limitation, we propose MDLMPE, a positional encoding designed specifically for masked diffusion. To the best of our knowledge, MDLMPE is the first method to make positional representations explicitly aware of the changing revealed/masked configuration. It represents token availability as a binary sequence, applies distance-aware Gaussian weighting, and projects the resulting pattern through a cosine basis to obtain distribution-aware positional features. These features are added to token embeddings and mapped by a lightweight MLP to angular offsets that modulate the standard RoPE phases. Extensive experiments on LLaDA and DREAM demonstrate that MDLMPE generally outperforms conventional positional encoding methods across supervised fine-tuning, pretraining, zero-shot evaluation, and block-diffusion settings. Further ablations show that the complete combination of availability state, Gaussian locality, spectral basis, and embedding injection yields the strongest result. These results establish the evolving token-availability distribution as a useful positional signal for masked diffusion language models.
2608.03769.paper_summary_zh: 被遮蔽的擴散語言模型（MDLMs）實現了平行生成和雙向上下文建模，但它們的位置信息與自回歸（AR）模型根本不同。自回歸解碼暴露了一個連續的前綴，而MDLM去噪則產生動態的、非連續的顯示和遮蔽標記配置。傳統的位置信息編碼，如RoPE，捕捉序列順序和成對位移，但對這種不斷變化的標記可用性結構仍然不敏感。為了解決這一局限性，我們提出了MDLMPE，一種專門為被遮蔽的擴散設計的位置信息編碼。據我們所知，MDLMPE是第一種使位置信息表示明確意識到變化的顯示/遮蔽配置的方法。它將標記可用性表示為二進制序列，應用距離感知的高斯加權，並通過餘弦基投影得到分佈感知的位置信息特徵。這些特徵被添加到標記嵌入中，並通過輕量級的MLP映射到調節標準RoPE相位的角度偏移。對LLaDA和DREAM的廣泛實驗表明，MDLMPE在監督微調、預訓練、零樣本評估和區塊擴散設置中通常優於傳統的位置信息編碼方法。進一步的消融實驗顯示，可用性狀態、高斯局部性、頻譜基和嵌入注入的完整組合產生了最強的結果。這些結果確立了不斷變化的標記可用性分佈作為被遮蔽的擴散語言模型的一個有用的位置信號。
